Why bridal studios stock a night cream

Brides ask their makeup artist what to do at home before the big day. A simple night cream gives you something to recommend, a small extra product for the studio, and a reason for the bride to message you again. It also helps skin feel soft before makeup, which makes your work easier.

Which cream suits which bride

Bride's skinCream to suggest
Dry or tightAvocado night cream, rich and cushioned
Normal to combinationKorean-inspired avocado night cream, medium texture
Dull and uneven-lookingGlutathione cream, for a brighter look over weeks
Oily or acne-proneA thin layer of the Korean-inspired cream, after a patch test

A simple pre-wedding routine you can share

  1. Cleanse gently every evening with a mild face wash.
  2. Apply a pea-sized amount of night cream and press it in.
  3. Use sunscreen every morning. It matters as much as the cream.
  4. Patch test any new cream at least two weeks before the wedding. Never start something new in the last week.
  5. Keep it simple. Do not add several new products close to the date.

Questions and answers

Can a bridal studio buy night cream in kg?

Yes, from 1 kg. Message us the cream and your city.

Can I get a sample?

Yes. We suggest a sample before every bulk order.

Will it make a bride's skin fairer?

No. It is a cosmetic moisturiser. It helps skin feel soft and look fresher, and it does not change natural skin colour.

When should a bride start?

Ideally 4 to 6 weeks before the wedding, after a patch test.
